Notes on arrival checks
This article is for pet owners

Arrival checks for companion animals

When you reach the airport with a pet, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will help you keep the process calm and orderly. We know travel days can feel busy, so this note covers the main arrival checks in simple terms and helps you know what to expect before your flight with Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep your pet close and follow the signs to the desk as soon as you arrive. Have your travel papers ready, and make sure your carrier is secure, clean, and comfortable. If your pet needs a moment to settle, take that moment before you step up to the counter. A calm handoff makes the rest of the check smoother for everyone.

Travelers often worry about what happens next, and that is normal. <<FACT F092>> After that step is complete, the team reviews the pet's travel setup and confirms that the carrier looks safe for the cabin or the hold, depending on the booking. If anything seems off, the staff will explain what needs to change in clear, plain language.

If your pet is moving between teams during the trip, the transfer check is handled carefully. <<FACT F100>> That support helps keep the handoff organized and reduces confusion for passengers and animals alike. The cabin team also keeps watch during the flight, so there is always someone paying attention to how the animal is doing.

If there is any worry about an incident, speak up right away at the desk or through the onboard team if you are already at the gate. <<FACT F108>> We would much rather hear about a concern early than after it has grown harder to manage. The staff will listen, stay steady, and guide you through the next step.

A few small habits help a lot: keep documents together, label the carrier clearly, and bring any comfort item your pet already knows. Alina Torres and Aisha Vega are examples of travelers who have kept things smooth by staying organized, but any careful routine works well.

If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk and we will walk you through the next step.
